<details class="guide-section" open><summary>Use the assigned scan</summary>

The current one-scan Colab notebook uses OpenNeuro dataset **ds004144**. Your task supplies the subject ID. Use that exact subject; do not choose a different scan. The notebook downloads the assigned image and saves its results to the shared Drive folder.

</details>
